recipe: read-only GRT, congestion_iterations 0, NO-PDN, clocks special, M4-M9 signal, adj M4-M5 0.30 / M6-M8 0.10 / M9 0.05, 4.8 um tiles (= SQC-QDIE5 'bs'); script probes/ftprobe.sh; runs gold1:/srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ft-qc-1023/r50-<v>
caveat: NO-PDN and coarse: at this recipe even the r50 baseline shows 0 overflow (r48 had 261.6k from reset pad bands), so the probes compare capacity, demand and wirelength, not overflow. Deleting cells (p2/p3) leaves their nets partial, a lower bound on demand.

p0.what: baseline r50 (synthetic b16 OBS M1-M8 full)

p1.what: b16 OBS M1-M7 (M8/M9 open over clusters)

p3.what: p2 + 705 landh0 landing halves removed (landing pushed into clusters)

p4.what: p2 + slice2 OBS M1-M7 full (real slice2 contract)

reading: Removing the synthetic M8 blanket multiplies die M8 capacity 3.5x (573M -> 2,008M); the real slice2 M6/M7 use costs M6/M7 capacity (481->300M, 684->317M) with no overflow. The landing halves (bc/rs q3h_far links) are half of all die wirelength (p3): the next lever after reset is landing the bc/rs links inside the receiving cluster.
